bane.description: #8 Add 1 fewer recharge token to this card.

chaosStar.description: You gain the Overwhelmed condition for 2 rounds.

conservative.requirements: 8 favour, target within medium range. If you are engaged with an enemy, add 1 {Dm} to the dice pool. Each time a recharge token is removed from this card, the target makes a Resilience (To) check opposed by your Discipline (WP). If he fails, he suffers 1 wound and 1 fatigue. The target gains the Overwhelmed condition while this card is recharging.
conservative.name: Watery Grave

success.description: As above but 2 wounds, 1 fatigue, and 1 stress each time a token is removed.

reckless.requirements: 8 favour, target within medium range. If you are engaged with an enemy, add 1 {Dm} to the dice pool. Effect: The target's lungs fill with seawater. Each time a recharge token is removed from this card, the target makes a Resilience (To) check opposed by Discipline (WP). If he fails, he suffers 1 wound and 1 fatigue. The target gains the Overwhelmed condition while this card is recharging.
